action_description: Added an H-tiled GEMM2 FP4 dequantization microkernel selected for 32-element scale blocks. Each one-warp CTA now covers one routed slot, one split, and an 8-column hidden tile, reuses a cooperatively loaded 32-element mid block across those columns, broadcasts packed FP4 words and scales with warp shuffles, and writes through the existing weighted atomic accumulation path. The original scalar GEMM2 kernel remains as fallback for non-32-element scale vectors.
